name: Integration and Release Workflow
description: Standard operating procedure for merging parallel code streams, resolving conflicts, validating builds, running comprehensive test suites, and signing off on release.

steps.name: Source Tree Harmonization
steps.action: Inspect branches/changes, check ownership adherence, detect file clashes

steps.name: Integration Build & Unit Tests
steps.action: Execute build scripts and run core unit tests

steps.name: E2E and Regression Suite
steps.action: Run full regression and browser end-to-end tests

steps.name: Security & Architecture Review
steps.action: Audit codebase for vulnerabilities, secrets, and architecture compliance
